name: evolutional-agent-structure
description: HELM — container for the dsh-hive DSH-plugin pnpm monorepo (dsh-hive/), its install kit (dsh-hive-dist/) and the plugin docs. The OpenCode plugin surface (src/, commands/, rules/, agents/, test/, fixtures/, the absorbed board viewer, svcwatch, oc-browser-bridge) was retired 2026-11-27 with the DSH-only move; the live DSH plugins are dsh-hive/packages/*, composed via the DSH profile, and the dsh-package-fit recommendation is the architecture of record.
